macros.token: #if $sequence_files #for $i, $sf in enumerate($sequence_files) ln -s '$sf' seq_${i}.fa && #end for #end if

param.name: alignment
param.label: Alignment file(s)
param.help: One or more pairwise alignment files in PAF format (use 'minimap2 --eqx' or 'wfmash' output). May be bgzipped (.paf.gz). impg builds a reusable '.impg' index next to the input.

param.label: Merge distance
param.help: Merge query-gathered ranges separated by at most this many bp. Also the largest internal gap/SV a single query hop can absorb. Accepts k/m/g suffixes (e.g. 50k, 1m). Use 0 to merge only overlapping/touching ranges.

validator.message: A non-negative integer, optionally followed by k, m, or g (e.g. 1000, 50k, 1m)

param.name: target_range
param.label: Target range
param.help: Format 'seq_name:start-end', e.g. 'chr1:1000-2000'. The split is on the *last* colon, so names that already contain coordinates (e.g. 'grch38#chr6:31972046-32055647') need an explicit trailing sub-range like 'grch38#chr6:31972046-32055647:0-10000'.

validator.message: Use the format seq_name:start-end with non-negative integers

param.name: sequence_files
param.label: Sequence files
param.help: Source FASTA(s) (optionally gzipped) for the sequences referenced in the alignment. Required for fasta / gfa / maf / vcf output.

param.label: Walk transitive closure
param.help: Find everything aligned to the initial result, recursively (BFS by default).

param.label: Use DFS instead of BFS
param.help: Depth-first search returns fewer, less overlapping results but is slower.

param.label: Max recursion depth
param.help: Maximum recursion depth for transitive overlaps (0 = no limit).

param.label: Min transitive region size
param.help: Minimum region size (bp) to consider for transitive queries.

param.label: Min distance between transitive ranges
param.help: Minimum distance (bp) between transitive ranges on the same sequence.

param.label: Min result identity
param.help: Minimum gap-compressed identity threshold (0.0-1.0) for reported results.

param.label: Min output length
param.help: Filter results shorter than this length (bp).

param.label: Subset sequence list
param.help: Restrict results to the sequence names listed in this file (one per line). Also filters transitive intermediates.

param.label: Consider strandness when merging
param.help: Keep strands separate while merging output intervals (default merges strands for bed/gfa/maf).

param.label: Disable merging
param.help: Explicitly disable merging of gathered ranges before output.

param.label: Force rebuild index
param.help: Rebuild the '.impg' index even if it already exists and is up-to-date.

param.label: Unidirectional interpretation
param.help: Disable bidirectional alignment interpretation. By default every A->B alignment creates an implicit B->A reverse mapping.

param.label: Trace spacing
param.help: Trace spacing for .1aln/.tpa alignment files (used when converting tracepoints to CIGAR). Ignored for plain PAF.

param.label: Use original-sequence coordinates
param.help: Update coordinates to the original sequences when input sequences are subsequences named 'seq_name:start-end'. Applies to bed, bedpe, and paf output.
